Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art FULL BODY animation sprite sheet, sequel to reference image 1. The input is a CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCE, not a layout to preserve.
Create EXACTLY 24 isolated full-body poses, arranged EXACTLY FOUR columns and SIX rows on flat solid #FF00FF magenta. No text, no grids, no shadows on background, no VFX, no trails. Portrait sheet. Each cell has generous margin; no touching between figures. Every figure is the SAME SIZE with same feet baseline within row, consistent head proportions and clothing.
Same tousled dark brown hair, thick rectangular black glasses, short beard, black sweatshirt, black trousers and sneakers. Same pixel-art aesthetic and silhouette as reference. Holds ONE short rusty grey metal pipe with a bent end firmly in BOTH hands, never a hammer or sword. All figures face RIGHT, feet and face remain facing right, never turn around. Show weight shifts, planted feet and deliberate whole-body motion.
Read cells row-major 0..23. Each group of EIGHT cells is ONE complete forward strike animation:
0 ready with pipe diagonally upright in FRONT of chest; 1 draws pipe toward shoulder; 2 coiled backswing near shoulder, knees load; 3 forceful FORWARD strike pipe extending horizontally to RIGHT at chest height; 4 pipe swings forward DOWN to right at waist height, still reaching the target; 5 finishes low right leaning on front foot; 6 draws pipe back upward toward chest, NOT an attacking reverse swing; 7 ready with pipe diagonally upright in FRONT of chest, matching frame0.
8 identical ready pose to7; 9 lower stance drawing pipe toward shoulder; 10 deeper coiled backswing; 11 strong FORWARD strike at chest height to RIGHT; 12 forward DOWN follow-through at waist height to RIGHT; 13 low finish with weight on right/front foot; 14 retracts close to chest; 15 ready upright pipe FRONT of chest matching frame0.
16 ready matching15; 17 raises pipe above head with both hands; 18 deep powerful OVERHEAD preparation, bent knees and arched torso; 19 smashes diagonally FORWARD DOWN toward RIGHT at chest/waist height (target is not the ground beneath hero); 20 forceful low FORWARD slam to RIGHT at knee height, extended arms and deep planted stance; 21 low follow-through to RIGHT, strong shoulder weight; 22 lifts pipe close toward chest; 23 ready matching0.
Only the ACTIVE poses 3/4,11/12,19/20 extend weapon forward. Readable intermediate poses, progressive motion, no detached limbs, no motion blur. All 24 characters completely contained, uniform scale, crisp pixels, preserve identity.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite animation sheet. Reference image is CHARACTER AND STYLE reference. Generate exactly TWELVE separate FULL BODY figures in FOUR columns and THREE rows. Solid flat #FF00FF magenta background, no text, no grid, no shadows, no blood particles or effects, no other characters.
Match exact enemies from reference: row1 the gaunt grey undead man in ragged dark green long coat, row2 hooded gaunt grey spitter in ragged purple robe, row3 black rotten dog with orange eyes. All face RIGHT, consistent size within each row, completely contained and generously spaced. Same crisp pixel art, palette and proportions.
Each row is FOUR successive HURT RECOIL poses from being struck FROM THE RIGHT: first impact head snaps backward to LEFT while feet stay planted, torso bends back; second deepest recoil LEFT with arms flinching loosely and knees folding; third rebalances weight crouching, head still facing RIGHT; fourth rises toward hunched ready stance. Dog: head jerk left/back and forelegs braced; deeper recoil ears folded and forepaws lifted slightly; low crouch regaining balance; standard low right-facing ready stance. These are not attacks or walk poses. Keep all heads facing right despite backward recoil. Whole body drawings with intact connected limbs. No weapons, no invented clothing, no contact flashes. Four unambiguously distinct poses per character.
